title: Each domain serves only its own site
description:
The edge must map a host to a site.

```gherkin
Feature: Host to site

  Scenario: Two domains, two sites
    Given two sites on one deployment
    When a reader opens each domain
    Then each shows its own home page, feed and sitemap

  Scenario: An unknown host is refused
    Given a host that no site owns
    When a reader opens it
    Then they get a not-found page
```
